The player must start a run in

and enter the stage's doors a total of 46 times, which can be done across any number of runs. Entering the 46th door sends the player into a dark room with a coffin. Interacting with the coffin unlocks Rose De Infernas as a playable character. If you leave the coffin room without interacting, the room reappears after another 46 doors.
Once unlocked, Rose De Infernas can be purchased for
5,000, which scales with other characters purchased.

At first glance, Rose might not seem like a strong character, with her reduced initial stats, lack of endless scaling, and seemingly detrimental ability. However, she starts with the powerful Fuwalafuwaloo, which provides a lot of healing that should easily keep her alive against the hordes she attracts. Once Rose finally sheds her stunted Growth, she can skyrocket in level thanks to the massive amount of enemies, potentially allowing her to have very powerful weapons with Limit Break enabled.
It is also a good idea to increase her Might and Growth by picking
and
earlier.
Rose has the unique ability to increase the number of incoming enemies without boosting the
stat. This means that while she will always face massive hordes, the enemies will not be any stronger or tougher than normal, allowing them to be wiped out with relative ease.
Due to the amount of enemies Rose will constantly be facing, it is recommended to favor weapons that can cover the whole screen.

Double Curse is rarely a problem for Rose, even in the early game, as Fuwalafuwaloo should usually be sufficient to keep her alive.
